g.text: Checked route (within the model), same destination

Comparison at each place's leave-by deadline toward the destination of its default checked route. Model-relative results for recorded 2025 fire scenarios (4 scenario members per input time, drawn per cell from the forecast; 1-hour
horizon; OSM roads at an assumed 40 km/h, no congestion). Not evacuation outcomes. Planning aid only - not for live evacuation operations.
